_comment: Curated condition interpretation bands (TERC-52) — the source of truth the seeder pushes into the condition_bands taxonomy. Metric keys and field names match the vocabulary on tercdev (verified 2026-08-31). max is the band's EXCLUSIVE upper bound in the metric's display unit; null = open-ended top band (exactly one per metric). Sentences are draft placeholders pending TERC science review — editors refine them in Drupal after seeding; re-running the seeder then reports 'update' diffs, so only run it to intentionally reset to this file.

bands.label: Very cold
bands.sentence: Dangerously cold for swimming — cold-water shock is a real risk. Wetsuits essential, stay close to shore.

bands.label: Cold
bands.sentence: Cold enough to take your breath away — keep swims short or wear a wetsuit.

bands.label: Cool
bands.sentence: Refreshing but chilly — fine for a quick swim on a hot day, cold for a long soak.

bands.label: Pleasant
bands.sentence: Comfortable swimming temperatures by mountain-lake standards.

bands.label: Warm
bands.sentence: Unusually warm for Tahoe — easy swimming, and worth savoring.

bands.label: Calm
bands.sentence: Flat water — ideal for paddleboarding, kayaking, and swimming.

bands.label: Light chop
bands.sentence: Small waves — fine for most boats, a bit of a workout for paddlers.

bands.label: Choppy
bands.sentence: Rough going for paddlecraft and small boats — stay near shore and wear a life vest.

bands.label: Rough
bands.sentence: Large waves for Tahoe — hazardous for small craft; consider staying off the water.

bands.label: Freezing
bands.sentence: Below freezing — bundle up, and watch for icy footing along the shore.

bands.label: Cold
bands.sentence: A cold day at the lake — dress in warm layers.

bands.label: Cool
bands.sentence: Cool air — comfortable for hiking and paddling; bring a layer for out on the water.

bands.label: Pleasant
bands.sentence: Comfortable air temperatures for just about anything on or off the water.

bands.label: Hot
bands.sentence: A hot one for Tahoe — sun builds fast at altitude, so plan for shade and water.

bands.label: Light air
bands.sentence: Barely a breeze — glassy water and easy paddling.

bands.label: Breezy
bands.sentence: A steady breeze — expect some chop away from shore; fine for most boats.

bands.label: Windy
bands.sentence: Strong enough to build whitecaps — paddlers should stay close to shore.

bands.label: Very windy
bands.sentence: Strong wind — small-craft caution; expect rough water and blowing sand at beaches.

bands.label: Low oxygen
bands.sentence: Oxygen is on the low side right now — fish often move deeper and bite less until levels recover.

bands.label: Moderate
bands.sentence: Enough oxygen for healthy aquatic life, though fish may be a little less active than usual.

bands.label: Healthy
bands.sentence: Well-oxygenated water — good conditions for fish and everything else living in the lake.

bands.label: Supersaturated
bands.sentence: Daytime photosynthesis has pushed oxygen above 100% — a normal sunny-afternoon pattern; fish are typically active.

bands.label: Crystal clear
bands.sentence: Exceptional clarity — you can see far into the water. Classic Tahoe.

bands.label: Clear
bands.sentence: Clear water with good visibility for swimming and snorkeling.

bands.label: Slightly cloudy
bands.sentence: Some suspended sediment — visibility is reduced, which is common after wind, waves, or runoff.

bands.label: Murky
bands.sentence: Poor visibility from stirred-up sediment — swimming and sight-fishing will be limited today.

bands.label: Typical for Tahoe
bands.sentence: Dissolved-mineral levels are in the lake's normal range.

bands.label: Elevated
bands.sentence: More dissolved material than Tahoe's baseline — often follows storm runoff.

bands.label: High
bands.sentence: Unusually high dissolved solids — can indicate strong runoff or a nearby inflow.

bands.label: Very low algae
bands.sentence: Almost no algae in the water — clarity is at its best.

bands.label: Some algae
bands.sentence: Modest algae growth — normal for near-shore water in summer.

bands.label: High algae
bands.sentence: Noticeable algae — the water may look greenish near shore.

bands.label: Bloom-level algae
bands.sentence: Algae at bloom levels — avoid swallowing water and rinse off after swimming.
